_doc: Registry of 3D figure scenes. A chapter block {"t": "fig3d", "scene": <name>, "records": [...]} may only name a scene listed here (and not a demo one), and only records of the kinds listed. fig3d.py (build), check_site.py (fig3d-scenes) and the bundle (one module per scene in scenes/<name>.js) all read this file. See docs/whiteboard/ebook/INTERACTIVE.md.
